_comment: Settings for npm run images. Changing anything here (or the style prompt / reference images) regenerates all images on the next run.
modelNote: gpt-image-2.6-sunburst is not available in the ElevenLabs API yet (the API only accepts gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.5-flare and older). Until it is, the images are recreated manually by hand and this script is not used. If you want to try it anyway, set the model to gpt-image-2.5-sunburst.
skipDaysNote: Days listed here are never generated by the script (not even with --force), e.g. because their images were made by hand.
seedNote: Only the ByteDance Seedream models accept a seed (the API rejects it on other models, so it is ignored for gpt-image). For a consistent look with gpt-image use stylePrompt and styleReferences.
stylePrompt: Painterly cinematic illustration, Art Deco grand Viennese hotel in the winter of 1926, deep navy and midnight-blue shadows with warm gold lamplight, falling snow, rich brushwork and fine film grain, moody and magical, no text, no captions, no watermark.
